about.title: Who is Lucas Tavares
about.p1: About me — personal: I'm Lucas Tavares, better known online as Necromante — or Necro to friends. I'm an Analysis and Systems Development (ADS) undergrad, YouTuber at Necromante96Official and a constantly evolving DEV, always learning and chasing new knowledge. A gaming enthusiast, I enjoy building and learning by doing with engines like RPG Maker MZ. Outside code, I frequently create YouTube thumbnails, banners, flyers, visual effects and religious invitations, bringing the same attention to detail I use in development to design and communication.
about.p2: What I do — technical: On the technical side, I built FisioHub for the Physiotherapy Clinic of ESEFID at the Federal University of Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS) — an offline, private system in TypeScript 5.9 + Vite + 3 Chrome Extensions (MV3) with ZenFisio import, per-physio dashboards and data that never leaves the device — and the Finance Control PWA (offline-first, vanilla JS + HTML5/CSS3, build 281, MIT, Capacitor). On the hardcore side, I built the Forbidden Legacy Patch Manager (65% C# .NET 9 + Avalonia and 35% Python + pycryptodome, Godot PCK v4 reverse with GDRE/GDScript and AES) and Nexus Translator (31 modules, 82% TypeScript + Python/UnityPy, Cursor SDK + Ollama for Stardew Valley, Hytale, Unreal and Unity IL2CPP/Mono). I ship unofficial translations authorized via Discord by the devs themselves — Stardew Valley, Hytale, Forsaken Realms: Vahrin's Call, Elementallis and Dragon Quest I & II HD-2D Remake — with LQA pipelines, glossaries and ZIPs, plus RPG Skills Mod (Java 17 + Gradle, 33 classes, 19 passives, 12 locales, 18.5k views), Ancient Souls (The Chronicles of Ancient Souls) in RPG Maker MZ with 12+ AS_* plugins and 500+ assets, Deck Building System, OBS Overlay Timer Action! (WDA_EXCLUDE), MO2Tools and RPG Skills Site (premium 11-page vanilla showcase).
about.p3: My philosophy is simple on the surface, solid underneath: premium minimal design, performance, accessibility and docs that hold up. I prefer offline, privacy-respecting systems that outlive me — like FisioHub and the finance PWA. Today I work with Vibe Coding, orchestrating cutting-edge AI to turn weeks and months of manual code into hours of delivery with engineering rigor: I architect, AI accelerates, I review in detail, test and ship.

about.philosophy.title: Philosophy
about.philosophy.p1: Simple on the surface, solid underneath. Readable code, docs that answer before you ask, and UI that doesn't fight for attention. I prefer offline, privacy-respecting systems that outlive me: like FisioHub (data never leaves device) and the finance PWA.
about.philosophy.li1: Premium minimal design, balanced light/dark, breathing typography.
about.philosophy.li2: Lean stack: vanilla when possible, framework when it pays off.
about.philosophy.li3: Translation is engineering + LQA: authorized unofficial mods, glossaries, zero leaks and respect for devs.
